projects.name: The program supported Study Group’s student insurance operations, where international students
details: undertaking short- and long-term study programs in the UK were provided insurance coverage through Zurich Insurance.
The solution enabled Study Group to manage end-to-end insurance-related requests and interactions across policy
administration, customer servicing, billing, claims, and third-party systems.
Key Responsibilities:
• Gathered and analyzed business requirements and translated them into BRDs, FRDs, Epics, User Stories,
Acceptance Criteria, and functional specifications.
• Conducted AS-IS, TO-BE, and gap analysis, identifying process improvements and integration requirements.
• Worked closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, Architects, Developers, QA, and third-party vendors
to ensure successful solution delivery.
• Led requirement discussions and supported backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, UAT, and release
readiness within Agile delivery.
• Defined and validated Salesforce, API, Guidewire, and third-party integration requirements, including data
mapping and business rules.
• Worked on Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter implementations, integrations, functional
validation, and business process alignment.
• Supported functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing by preparing scenarios, validating results,
managing defects, and coordinating with QA teams.
• Managed stakeholder communication, dependencies, risks, issues, and cross-team coordination across multi- vendor delivery environments.
• Ensured requirements traceability from business objectives → requirements → user stories → development →
testing → UAT → production release.
